cards.card_text: The newcomers rename Laish ___, after the forefather of their tribe, who was born to Israel.

cards.card_text: God says the people of Judah and Jerusalem have returned to the sins of their forefathers.

cards.snippet: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers who refused to obey My words.

cards.card_text: The LORD promises to return the Israelites to the land He gave their forefathers.
cards.verse_text: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
cards.snippet: …I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He gave this same command to their forefathers.
cards.verse_text: You must not carry a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath day, but you must keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your forefathers.
cards.snippet: …you must keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your forefathers.

cards.card_text: The LORD reminds them of the covenant He made with their forefathers when He brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.card_text: What does He say about the words their forefather Jonadab gave them?
cards.verse_text: He commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk it to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather.
cards.snippet: …to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather.

cards.card_text: Judah hasn't listened, and God sets the two side by side: Jonadab's sons kept their forefather's command, but these people have not listened to Him.
cards.verse_text: Yes, the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.
cards.snippet: …the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.

cards.card_text: Then, God says, they'll live in the land He gave their forefathers.

cards.card_text: Now he opens up the old family photo album: he doesn't want them unaware about “our forefathers.” Every last one of them was under the cloud.
cards.verse_text: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
